description: T-4628: Excel's form of a reference to a deleted sheet. Stored in the file, every #REF!<ref> form (SUM(#REF!C4:C7), #REF!$A$1, #REF!A1, ISREF(#REF!A1), #REF!A:A, #REF!1:2) makes Excel for the web refuse the workbook, dynamic-array or legacy <f> alike, so only the bare SUM(#REF!) is stored here; the #REF!<ref> forms are typed in after load (Graph entry) instead, each with its FORMULATEXT (docs/excel-semantics/references.md "A deleted table or sheet").
